propositions: Extend push_tickets_branch with keyword-only strict parameter (default False) to enable fail-loud semantics while preserving backward compatibility for all existing callers.
Implement five-attempt push-first loop with fetch+merge only on retriable non-fast-forward rejection, followed by exactly one terminal sixth push when the fifth attempt produces a clean merge.
Define reusable catchable PushDeliveryError carrying a machine-stable reason (one of ten pinned values), underlying git/config detail, and unpushed commit count for all strict branches.
Preserve warning-and-return behavior byte-for-byte for best-effort paths while introducing opt-in strict delivery that never calls sys.exit or writes process streams from core.
Add private module CLI adapter (python -m rebar._store.push push) as sole process boundary that catches PushDeliveryError, writes to stderr, and returns nonzero; existing callers remain best-effort.

Provide parametrized caller-contract proof over event append, batch append, NDJSON import, transition close, delete, compact, and claim operations confirming each omits strict or reaches core with strict=False while inheriting five-cycle plus terminal-push durability correction.
